_about: DELTA's own contracts table (legal compliance plan, step 8). Built from public news reports and the draft, never copied from OverTheCap or Spotrac pages; every row names its source. NOTHING ON THE SITE READS THIS FILE YET: the site keeps using the nflverse/OTC feed until the table is complete and the owner has seen a before-and-after list of every DELTA Score it would move. The Score reads only `end` (last season under contract). `aav` and `total` are in millions and display-only; null means none shown (rookie deals show 'Rookie Deal'). `kind`: rookie, rookie_option (fifth-year option picked up), veteran (new deal), extension (years added to a running deal; new years start after the old ones), franchise_tag, practice_squad, free_agent (no current contract: `end` null, which the Score treats as neutral). `option` (first-rounders only): `exercised` = the team picked up the fifth-year option and that year is counted in `end`; `available` = not decided yet, so `end` stops after year four and the page shows "Fifth-Year Option Available" with no date (owner, 25 Oct 2026: teams can decide any time in `window`, which is kept only so we know when to re-check); `declined` = no fifth year. A row with `pending` waits on the owner because it disagrees with the feed. Rows that agree with the feed went in without owner review (owner's rule, 25 Oct 2026).
rookie_rule: Drafted players: four-year deal, draft year to draft year + 3. First-rounders add draft year + 4 only once the team picks up the fifth-year option (decided each May of year + 3). Players from the last three classes cannot sign extensions until after their third season.

contract_rule: Owner, 25 Oct 2026: `end` is the last playable season written into the contract, even when the team can decline, cut or void later years. Never counted: void years (salary-cap placeholders that can never be played) and a first-rounder's fifth-year option until the team picks it up (that year is not in the rookie deal until then). Owner exception: a player who has left his team and stopped reporting (no longer with the team, though it holds his rights) counts as no contract, kind `left_team` (Brandon Aiyuk).
